perf.pprof.desc: Opening these from a remote machine is refused by design — not broken: the pprof endpoints only accept connections from the machine running the Hub (127.0.0.1). Use a browser or curl on that host; for remote profiling use an SSH tunnel, or explicitly enable the pprof plugin option allowRemote (this system has no auth, so enabling it exposes heap contents to the LAN).
perf.pprof.hint: These endpoints return 404 when the pprof plugin is disabled; enable it and the heap / goroutine numbers here get more complete too.
